title: PackageManifest
description: One manifest format for every package kind (plugin, skill, app, companion, integration, model, wakeword, voice, theme, module). See platform plan 5.1 and .github's docs/PACKAGES.md.

id.description: Unique in the catalog. No third-party name in it.

kind.description: A `plugin` is a self-contained, permissioned, installable capability (its own network access, its own recipe.json). A `skill` is plain instructions (a SKILL.md body, Claude-format-compatible) - no permissions, no recipe, composed into the chat model's system prompt when relevant, never runs on its own. See home/docs/dev.md's 'Naming: skill, plugin, command, connector' entry.

examples.description: Five or more, required at bronze (docs/PACKAGES.md).

companion.description: Required when kind is "companion" (session-a-intelligence.md step 8), unused otherwise. Composed by home/backend/src/lib/persona.ts into the turn engine's identity line and system-prompt fragment: display_name replaces the hardcoded "MaiPai" in "You are {display_name}, ...", the four style dials are the same ones lib/persona.ts already had before companions were packages, and examples is a short few-shot block (legacy's own finding: "the single biggest lever for small-model voice fidelity").

backstory.description: Short by design: no authoring UI exists yet to keep a longer one consistent with itself turn to turn (docs/dev.md's persona research).

examples.description: 3 to 5 lines in the character's own voice, composed as a few-shot block.

args.description: A JSON Schema for this package's call arguments.

requires.description: Capabilities from the capability vocabulary (spec/vocab/capabilities.json) this package cannot run without.

optional.description: Capabilities that add behavior but are not required.

min_role.description: The floor role a person needs to invoke this package.

consequential.description: Raises the routing bar (4.5): a consequential plugin needs more confidence before it fires.

offline.description: Stated offline behavior, required at bronze.

data_sources.description: Feeds the generated privacy row (docs/ENGINEERING.md > Privacy). The shape is @maipai/standards' PrivacyRow, imported by $ref (std-v0.2.0).

id.description: Namespaced by the package's own id (e.g. `weather.severe_alert`) so two packages can never collide in F's shared registry.

notifications.description: Notification types this package declares, per docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md - registered into home/backend/src/lib/notificationTypes.ts's shared registry at load (registerPackageNotificationTypes()).

cache.description: How lib/packageCache.ts (session-d-packages-and-store.md step 3) keys and bounds this package's own cache. `additionalProperties: true` on purpose: a package's `host.fetch` call sites decide their own extra per-entry hints (4.10), this just fixes the ones the cache mechanism itself reads.

key_template.description: A `{arg}`-interpolated template (e.g. `weather:{place}`) naming one cache entry per distinct call.

ttl_s.description: Fresh for this long; served straight from cache with no fetch.

stale_ok_s.description: Beyond ttl_s but within this, served immediately while a revalidation fetch runs in the background (stale-while-revalidate).

max_bytes.description: Per-entry size ceiling; a fetch response over this is never cached.

warm.description: A scheduled job that pre-populates this package's cache before anyone asks, so a common answer (the household's own weather) never waits on a live fetch.

schedule.description: The same `every:<n><m|h|d>` grammar lib/scheduler.ts's core jobs already use.

keys.description: The recipe inputs to warm with, one object per cache entry (e.g. `[{ "place": "household's home place" }]`); resolved against household settings/state at warm time, not stored as literal values here.

warm_on.description: Setting keys (spec/settings/keys.json ids) whose change should trigger an immediate warm outside `warm.schedule` - e.g. `household.home_place` changing re-warms `weather` right away instead of waiting for the next scheduled tick.

contributes.description: Shell blueprints (6.1): nav entries, pages, right-pane panels, settings sections, commands, quick actions, player hooks, admin sections. `additionalProperties: true` since most of 6.1's own blueprint kinds have no bundled package using them yet (Wave 1's `contributes: []` was a placeholder no package had populated); `widgets` below is the one sub-field session-d-packages-and-store.md step 2 fixes a real shape for, since step 9 ships packages that populate it.

refresh_s.description: How often Home should re-fetch this widget's data; the data itself still only ever comes from lib/packageCache.ts (step 3's own rule: never a live fetch in the request path).

inputs.description: Resolved the same way `warm.keys` are - against household settings/state, not literal values in the manifest.

widgets.description: wave-2.md's D-to-E contract: `GET /api/widgets` and `GET /api/widgets/:package/:id/data` list and serve these.

pages.description: Ids of UI schema page documents this package ships (6.2).

setup.description: A declared setup flow, the one escape hatch beyond a plain settings form (docs/SETTINGS.md rule 1).

provides.description: For integrations: what this package makes available to others (5.4).

min_app.description: Minimum hub/robot version this package needs.

kit_version.description: The @maipai/ui ui-v tag this package's UI was built against, if it ships one.

reply.description: Default reply shape hints for the router, if any.

timeout_ms.description: Bounds handle(). Defaults per 4.9: 4000 on the robot, 8000 on the hub.

fallback_reply.description: A Tier 1 package's own answer when its Deno process crashes or times out (session-d-packages-and-store.md step 5) - required practically, not just structurally, for a Tier 1 package to clear bronze, since a crash with nothing to say is a dead end for whoever asked.

tier.description: 0: declarative (a recipe or prompt body). 1: Deno code.

smoke.description: The smoke test entry, run at install, update, and on a schedule (lib/smoke.ts). `kind: "static"` (loads only), `"recipe_fixture"` + `fixture` (a Tier 0 plugin's own recipe run against a fixture-seeded HostEmulator), or `"deno_test"` (Tier 1, session-d step 5).

fixture.description: Path, relative to the package's own directory, to its smoke fixture. Required when kind is "recipe_fixture".

exposes.description: wave-2.md's C-to-D contract: typed read queries a package offers beyond its own recipe, for C's Tier 2 tool-calling router to call directly rather than routing a whole turn through this package's `handle`.

args.description: A JSON Schema for this query's arguments.

returns.description: A JSON Schema for this query's result.

channel.description: The release channel this manifest version was published under (session-d step 6's store). A household's own per-package channel *choice* is store-side state, not this field - this is the publisher's declaration of what the version itself is.

source.description: For a package that graduated to its own repo (5.1).
